# Utkarsh Sinha

> QA Automation Architect and AI-Driven Quality Engineering Leader. Portfolio: https://utkarsh-sinha.com/

Utkarsh Sinha is a QA Automation Architect based in Gurgaon, Haryana, India. The site describes 18+ years in enterprise testing across BFSI, healthcare, e-commerce, and supply chain. The current role listed on the site is Manager – Program Manager (Release & Automation) at Fidelity International.
